name: Ellipsis

modes.label: On-demand
modes.note: Environment schema: compute.cpu 2-32 vCPU (default 2), compute.memory 4 GB-64 GB (default 4 GB); compute.timeout 60 s to 1 h (default 1 h), meaning not defined further. Org compute is paid from prepaid credits that carry the 20% platform fee (multiplier 1.2).

modes.label: Own AWS VPC
modes.note: AWS infrastructure (billed by AWS) plus Ellipsis 20% platform fee; rates depend on AWS.

plans.name: Personal account
plans.note: CPU and memory are free on personal accounts; tokens via Ellipsis credits (+20% fee) or $0 when using your own Claude/Codex subscription. Only sessions you start yourself.

free.note: No sign-up credit on the pricing page; open-source maintainers get free usage case by case. Credits are prepaid, do not expire; paid requests stop when balance or a spend limit is exhausted; automatic recharge is opt-in.

caveats: Managed SaaS CPU $0.142/vCPU-hour and memory $0.024/GB-hour plus a 20% platform fee (charged on credit purchases, i.e. on token and compute spend). No per-seat or idle charges. Active lifecycle is not confirmed per-core utilization billing.
BYOC uses customer AWS compute and a 20% platform fee; cannot reuse SaaS resource rates. Support $5k/$10k/$15k per month is optional, not required plan.
YC mentions $100 credit; current pricing page did not confirm eligibility, so no unconditional free credit encoded.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.

Re-checked 2026-09-28 (ellipsis.dev/pricing, ellipsis.dev/llms.txt): Managed SaaS CPU $0.142/vCPU-h and memory $0.024/GB-h confirmed; NO published disk, snapshot or egress price, no SSH, desktop or browser statement, no sandbox size limit or billing granularity. These stay null (unknown, not free/absent).
Coding-agent platform: sandboxes run Ellipsis agent sessions (automations, @ellipsis), billed tokens + 20% platform fee (not modeled).
Session budget default $250 and hard max $250 per session; agent/handler defaults $1,000/day, $10,000/week, $40,000 per 28 days. Support packages $5,000/$10,000/$15,000 per month are optional.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

fleet.notes: API > Limits shows per-account API request limits, storage quotas, concurrency limits and spending ceilings; values are not published. Increases are requested in the shared Slack channel with the Ellipsis team or via Help.
